updates.title: Learn to Play registration is open
updates.body: Session 1 runs eight Saturday mornings, 8:15 to 9:15: September 26, October 3, 10, 17, 24, November 7, December 5, and December 12. No sessions October 31, November 14, 21, or 28. Full gear is required from day one. Registration closes September 20. Head to the Learn to Play page to get the registration link.

updates.title: John Anderson voted onto the LYHA board as Head of Learn to Play
updates.body: The LYHA board voted John Anderson in as Head of Learn to Play. He oversees the program where most Coyotes get their first season on ice.
